source_notes: GEM currently lists State/Province=Pernambuco, but the Porto de Sergipe FSRU (Energos/Golar Nanook, CELSE) sits ~6.5 km off Barra dos Coqueiros in the state of SERGIPE, not Pernambuco. GEM's own wiki and pt.wikipedia both place it in Sergipe. Clear data error; the terminal name itself is 'Sergipe'. Capacity/owner/vessel otherwise verified-current.

GEM has ProposalYear 2024 but no planned-start year. LC Terminais (Lyon Capital) targets construction start Oct 2026 and operations by Oct 2028 for the São Marcos Bay / Boa Razão Island FSRU (~US$108M). Single sponsor/trade source -> yellow; additive fill of a blank field. Could equally route to Update with corroboration.
